page: Amazon Web Services r8g.24xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores utilizing the custom 64-bit ARM architecture with AWS Neoverse-V2 processors running at 2.8 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage or GPU hardware bundled with this instance type, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights top-tier performance in memory bandwidth and multi-core processing. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark memory tests. Large-block memory read and write bandwidth benchmarks also place in the top tier, alongside Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core results falling in the average category, indicating a tradeoff where multi-threaded scale is prioritized over raw single-thread speed.

Given its high memory-to-core ratio and top-tier database operations performance, the r8g.24xlarge is suited for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, Redis caching layers, and software compilation. The ARM-based Graviton architecture offers resource density and high memory bandwidth, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for multi-threaded enterprise applications and medium-to-large LLM inference text generation, where it achieves top-tier performance.
